error_patterns.root_cause: The automated classifier's text parser flagged descriptive sentences starting with 'None; ...' as blocker strings, inappropriately downgrading 4 truly friction-free APIs from 'Buildable' to 'Buildable with limitations'.
error_patterns.impact: Artificially deflates the proportion of turn-key buildable integrations.
error_patterns.operational_remedy: Refine the blocker tokenization parser to strip leading 'None;' phrases before evaluating limitation strings.

error_patterns.pattern: Single-User Token vs Multi-Tenant App Credentials
error_patterns.root_cause: Platforms offering both internal integration tokens and public multi-tenant OAuth require distinguishing developer testing ease from end-user authorization complexity.
error_patterns.impact: Underestimating integration effort for end-user SaaS distribution.
error_patterns.operational_remedy: Separate 'Single-Workspace Feasibility' from 'Multi-Tenant Marketplace Feasibility' into distinct schema fields.

error_patterns.root_cause: Assuming major modern platforms expose event webhooks by default when some key platforms (e.g. Notion, Expensify) require periodic polling.
error_patterns.impact: Increased compute and API credit consumption for autonomous agent trigger workflows.
error_patterns.operational_remedy: Classify all polling-dependent architectures as 'Buildable with limitations' to account for server polling infrastructure.
